channel.title: CVE Daily — AI Curated
channel.description: The day's curated vulnerabilities reveal a severe concentration of critical remote code execution and memory corruption flaws across desktop operating systems, cloud platforms, network devices, and database engines. Microsoft Windows networking stacks, Azure cloud services, SQL Server, and ASP.NET Core represent the most heavily targeted environments, with unauthenticated access vectors, command injection, and deserialization weaknesses enabling rapid privilege escalation and infrastructure compromise. Additional high-risk issues affect web frameworks, enterprise office applications, and industrial control systems, highlighting an urgent need to patch core drivers, cloud integrations, and third-party middleware to mitigate widespread exploitation.
